verdict.rationale: Pipedream ships and documents an official CLI (`pd`) with commands like `pd deploy`, `pd dev`, and `pd help` for building/deploying event sources and components, confirmed by docs and a probe hit. It's a general developer CLI rather than one with AI-specific commands, but it clearly exists as an official tool usable by AI-native/developer users. Missing for 10: AI-specific CLI features (e.g., agent/prompt-driven commands) and independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI itself.
